title: Infrared Consistency and the Uniqueness of String Amplitudes
summary: Recent work has shown that maximal supersymmetry, combined with a particular scalar-parity condition at six points, imposes nonlinear constraints on four-point effective field theory amplitudes. Numerical bootstrap studies incorporating unitarity provide evidence for the Veneziano amplitude in maximally supersymmetric Yang--Mills theory and for the Virasoro--Shapiro amplitude, together with infinite-spin alternatives, in supergravity.
